QUOTE: "on cosmos_qa" METRIC: n/a ISSUE: No dataset is recorded in the config or metrics, so the dataset attribution is unsupported.
QUOTE: "the gap is larger than two standard errors" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: Only the treatment PGR has a reported standard error; with no baseline SE and n=3 seeds, the two-SE significance claim is not supported.
QUOTE: "PGR 0.48 (se 0.11)" METRIC: num_seeds ISSUE: The write-up omits that this is averaged over only 3 seeds, a caveat that materially weakens the precision claim.
